summary: Bit-mask remap helper used by BitFieldMaskMerge: reorders individual bit positions from one mask layout to another. Maps input bit 4 to output value 1, input bit 3 to output 4, input bit 2 to output 8, input bit 1 to output 16, input bit 0 to output 32, and input bit 19 (0x80000) to output 2. Near-inverse of sub_5950A3 over the shared low bits.

operations.description: Initialize result to (a1 & 0x10) != 0, i.e. set output bit 0 (value 1) when input bit 4 is set.
If input bit 3 (a1 & 8) is set, set result bit 2 (result |= 4).
If input bit 2 (a1 & 4) is set, set result bit 3 (result |= 8).
If input bit 1 (a1 & 2) is set, set result bit 4 (result |= 0x10).
If input bit 0 (a1 & 1) is set, set result bit 5 (result |= 0x20).
If input bit 19 (a1 & 0x80000) is set, return result with bit 1 set (result | 2).

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the two mask layouts (which field each bit represents) is not recoverable from this function alone.
Legacy ABI entry FAIL_595135 carries no usable prototype.
